Method of Attack: Spyware targeting ethnic and religious minorities, collecting precise location, installed apps list, call logs with geolocation, contacts list, SMS, complete device info, WiFi info, phone call recording, taking pictures, exfiltrating files or databases, accessing folders of high interest
Attack Vector: Distribution via third-party app stores and malicious websites, promoted on communication channels populated by targeted ethnic groups
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious C2 infrastructure linked to Chinese defense contractor Xi'an Tian He Defense Technology, exposed admin panels and GPS coordinates of test devices
